node.title: XR window-system descent: exact locator equations, quotient descent, single-word Toeplitz rank, and large-scale periodic liveness exclusion
node.statement: For H=mu_n and r'=n-k-d, a monic locator E_T of degree r' admits a degree-<k word agreeing off T iff the top d coefficients of uE_T mod (X^n-1) vanish. Coset-union locators E_T=G(X^M) descend exactly by residue classes to the quotient window system. Under the tangent gate each single-word Toeplitz matrix has full rank d; no joint rank 2d is claimed. For M=2^j|gcd(n,k,d), individually residue-supported word pairs at odd h can be exact-A live only if M<=floor((n-k-d)/(h-d)); this excludes all M>=2^21 throughout the prize-row high band. Common-class systems descend to strip P3. This proves no occupancy count; small-scale mixed-class and aperiodic systems remain.
